column3: Ledgerline 4.2 - Release Notes
Ledgerline 4.2 Release Notes
Released 9 June 2025 · Applies to self-hosted installations
Version 4.2 is a feature release that also changes how Ledgerline is configured. Hosted customers are upgraded automatically during the maintenance window of 15 June.
Highlights
Bank feeds can now be reconciled in bulk, with suggested matches ranked by confidence.
Multi-currency revaluation runs as a scheduled job instead of only at month end.
The audit trail records the client address and the API token used for every change.
PDF exports of reports are about three times faster on large ledgers.
Breaking changes
Read this section before upgrading, because two of these changes require action on your part.
The configuration file is now YAML; the old INI format is no longer read.
PostgreSQL 13 is the minimum supported database version.
The /api/v1 endpoints have been removed; use /api/v2 instead.
Configuration reference

KeyTypeDefaultDescriptionserver.portinteger8080TCP port on which the web interface listens.server.base _ urlstring(none)Public address used in e-mail links and in exported documents.database.urlstring(none)Connection string for the PostgreSQL database.database.pool _ sizeinteger10Maximum number of open database connections.jobs.revaluationcron0 2 * * *Schedule of the currency revaluation job.audit.retain _ daysinteger2555Number of days audit records are kept, about seven years.exports.workersinteger2Parallel workers used for PDF exports.

Upgrading from 4.1
The upgrade takes about ten minutes for a ledger of one million postings. Always take a full database backup before you begin.
Stop the Ledgerline service.
Back up the database and the existing configuration file.
Use pg_ dump with the custom format.
Copy ledgerline.ini to a safe place.
Convert the configuration file to YAML, as in the example below.
Install the new package and run the database migration.
Start the service and check the log for the line "Ledgerline ready" .
Example configuration

server: port: 8080 base _ url: https://ledger.example.org database: url: postgresql://ledgerline@db01/ledger pool _ size: 20 jobs: revaluation: "0 2 * * *" audit: retain _ days: 2555 exports: workers: 4
Migration commands
sudo systemctl stop ledgerline pg_ dump -Fc -f ledger-4.1.dump ledger sudo dpkg -i ledgerline _ 4.2.0 _ amd64.deb sudo -u ledgerline ledgerline migrate --to 4.2 sudo systemctl start ledgerline
Known issues
Reports with more than 200 columns may be cut off in the PDF export. A fix is planned for version 4.2.1. Please report other problems through the support portal.
